integrity: The analytic proof is self-contained relative to standard torus topology, Haar invariance and irrational-rotation density; finite computational tests are checks, not infinite verification. No independence or external certification is represented.
scientific_limitations: Only torus translations acting on continuous-function lattices; no arithmetic-uniform convergence rate. Rigidity requires dense rotation orbit and defect less than two. Possible unindexed cocycle literature remains a priority risk.
title: Sharp Lipschitz defect and optimizer rigidity for torus-rotation torsions
